input.reasoning_summary:
The initial verdict of SUPPORTED remains unchanged after investigating potential challenges. 

H1 (one-time items/acquisitions/accounting changes): The retrieved evidence discusses various items like the August 2026 multistate attorneys general agreement charge, tax changes, and infrastructure expenses, but none of these indicate that revenue itself was affected by one-time items, acquisitions, or accounting changes that would make the year-over-year comparison misleading. The charge mentioned in E19 affected operating income, not revenue. No relevant evidence was found to support this challenge.

H2 (restatements/corrections): The numeric check confirmed that Q3 2025 revenue was $51,242 million, exactly matching the comparison figure used in the growth calculation. No evidence of restatements or corrections to either Q3 2026 or Q3 2025 revenue figures was found. This challenge is refuted.

H3 (discontinued operations): While E18 mentions held-for-sale assets related to data centers, these are asset disposals, not discontinued operations affecting revenue comparability. No evidence indicates that revenue figures include discontinued operations or segments that should be excluded from year-over-year analysis.

The core evidence remains solid: Q3 2026 revenue was $64,601 million vs Q3 2025 revenue of $51,242 million, representing 26% growth, which exceeds the claim's threshold of "more than 20%."
